description: Section has POST /api/v1/scan accepts URL string but does not say whether URL must be base64-encoded before submitting to VirusTotal /urls endpoint
reason: Explicitly document URL base64 identifier generation in architecture section 5.1

description: Error envelope gives generic 500 status code but does not specify upstream 429 response body structure or Retry-After header propagation
reason: Define explicit error envelope schema for HTTP 429

description: Input validation schema gives max length 2048 chars but does not say whether leading or trailing whitespace is taken out before regex validation
reason: Add Pydantic validator rule to strip leading/trailing whitespace before length check

description: Sequence diagram shows polling stopping at 10.0s, but does not give exact HTTP status sent back to client when polling runs out while still 'queued'
reason: Standardize timeout behavior on HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout in section 5.2 and sequence diagram

description: CORS configuration has wildcard '*' for local development without defining origin lockdown for the Render static site domain
reason: Define explicit production CORS origin list in environment config section

description: UI state section talks about a loading spinner, but doesn't have a maximum client-side timeout abort threshold if backend drops connection without giving an error envelope
reason: Define explicit 12.0s frontend fetch abort timeout in UI component spec

description: Auditor Area 2 check flagged that HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity and HTTP 429 schemas are not documented in the interface contract
reason: Put in Pydantic 422 validation and 429 rate-limit error envelope JSON examples to section 5.3

description: Auditor Area 6 check says that Week 12 deployment gate relies on manual inspection instead of an automated verification script
reason: Update Week 12 gate description in docs/plan.md to make an automated curl health-check smoke test

description: Frontend has no rate-limiting or CAPTCHA; an attacker or bot can script requests against POST /api/v1/scan and use the 4 req/min VirusTotal API tier right away for all users
reason: Implement basic IP-based in-memory rate limiting (slowapi) on the FastAPI endpoint to keep users to 2 requests per minute

description: VT API v3 has a difference between submitting a URL for re-analysis and fetching an existing cached report; polling the analysis ID on an already-scanned URL burns analysis quota unnecessarily
reason: Checking cache first requires branching logic; defer to Week 10 (Iteration 1) under CR-001 so Week 9 walking skeleton stays focused

description: If a scan gives an HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout, the UI leaves the user stuck with no 'Retry' button, forcing a hard page refresh which clears form state
reason: Add an explicit retry button on error/timeout states in the UI component specification

description: Section 5.3 does not talk about backend behavior if VirusTotal comes back with an unexpected HTTP 403 Forbidden
reason: Add HTTP 403 mapping to give a 502 Bad Gateway to client while logging alert internally

description: Input validation regex checks domain format but does not restrict URL schemes, allowing dangerous or unsupported protocols through to the scanner
reason: Update Pydantic validator to use a strict http:// and https:// protocol schemes only

description: FastAPI background polling loop does not have handling for client disconnect; if a user navigates away, the server continues polling VT for 10s, burning rate limit quota
reason: Add request.is_disconnected() check inside the polling loop to abort upstream polling if client drops

description: AI asserted system fails to specify database encryption at rest for historical scan results
reason: System is stateless and has zero persistence.

description: AI flagged endpoint does not support batch array URL scanning in a single request payload
reason: Batch scanning was intentionally not included in Charter scoping to fit the 57-hour solo build budget; single-URL scanning is intentional.

description: AI claimed section 7.3 omits webhook retry policies for asynchronous callback delivery
reason: Made up finding: docs/architecture.md ends at Section 6, and FR-DAT-04 does not exist. System uses synchronous HTTP polling, not webhooks.

description: UI specification does not mandate explicit 'for' and 'id' pairing between the form label and the URL input element
reason: Explicitly mandate matching 'for' and 'id' HTML attributes in frontend component specification

description: URL scheme validation normalizer automatically appends trailing slashes to domain roots, creating mismatched base64 identifiers for VirusTotal cache lookups
reason: Strip trailing slashes from domain roots during canonicalization before base64 encoding
